summary: The prepared main checkout already contains the issue-specific fix from upstream PR #31255 (commit fc1e3797b77b): EAGLE draft CUDA graph admission rejects a batch when spec_info.num_tokens_per_req differs from the graph's captured_req_width. Without that guard, a one-request graph can receive two token rows and reach the reported [2, 2048] to [1, 2048] copy failure. This change adds regression coverage for mismatched, matching, and legacy-unset widths; no production source change was needed.

tests.what_was_measured: Six focused CPU tests passed, including rejection of width 2 by a graph captured at width 1 and independent matching/unset boundary cases.

tests.command: Temporarily remove only the #31255 width guard, then run test_rejects_width_mismatch_before_replay
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: without the existing fix, can_run_graph returned true for actual width 2 versus captured width 1. The source guard was restored verbatim afterward.

On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, copying a [2, 2048] int32 seed into a [1, 2048] destination raised the exact reported broadcast-shape error; the matching [1, 2048] boundary copied successfully with checksum 2096128, equal to the independent Python sum(range(2048)) reference.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015 reproduced the exact tensor-copy shape error and validated the matching-shape boundary.
remaining_limitations: GLM-5.2-FP8 and its draft-model weights were not available.
The reported TP16, two-node PD-disaggregated Mooncake deployment cannot be reproduced on the assigned single GPU.
GPU validation covers the reported tensor-shape failure mechanism, not model semantics, speculative acceptance quality, transport, or the full serving path.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
